load.broker: NATS 2.15.3 fixture (not exercised by this drill)
load.methodology: discrete percentiles using zero-based floor(count*rank/100) on sorted per-operation wall-clock microseconds; single tenant; every operation is one committed UOW transaction; one run with no confidence interval, affected by scheduler, network and timer precision

rpo.method: wall clock from last committed seed write to pg_dump snapshot start; a consistent pg_dump snapshot means zero committed rows can be missing; verified by full table equality

rto.method: wall clock from restore start to fresh-connection verified equality of every restored table
